description.fun: Ho-Oh was the first Generation 2 Pokémon ever revealed, in CoroCoro in August 1996, the first sign there would be more than 151 Pokémon, and it flew past at the end of the anime's very first episode. Its wings trail rainbows, and anyone who glimpses it is promised eternal happiness. After the Brass Tower fire, it brought three Pokémon back to life as the legendary beasts.
description.guide: A Fire- and Flying-type Legendary Pokémon resembling a phoenix, named after the Chinese fenghuang and the mascot of Pokémon Gold and HeartGold. Its wings trail rainbows, and it revived the three legendary beasts after the Brass Tower fire. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A rainbow phoenix whose sighting promises eternal happiness
